text:
Each variable's final value comes from its last direct assignment (a constant) plus every later increment, reduced mod 100. `TMP` is never reassigned after its first value of 18, so its value comes from summing every increment in the program. All of these are long hand sums. The eight letter variables were each re-scanned once against the program text. `TMP` has hundreds of increments and was summed in one pass without a second check, so it is the least certain result.

| Variable | Last constant assignment | Increments after it | Final value |
|---|---|---|---|
| a | `a <- 61` | 68 | 9 |
| b | `b <- 50` | 111 | 32 |
| c | `c <- 36` | 55 | 97 |
| d | `d <- 53` | 95 | 49 |
| e | `e <- 32` | 41 | 61 |
| f | `f <- 97` | 61 | 90 |
| g | `g <- 49` | 48 | 57 |
| h | `h <- 45` | 82 | 74 |
| TMP | `TMP <- 18` (start) | all | 74 |

ANSWER: a ?= 9; b ?= 32; c ?= 97; d ?= 49; e ?= 61; f ?= 90; g ?= 57; h ?= 74; TMP ?= 74;
